On July 8, 2011, NASA launched STS-135, the final Space Shuttle mission 🇺🇸
The shuttle you’re seeing here is Atlantis, lifting off from Kennedy Space Center for the very last time.

This launch marked the end of the Space Shuttle program after 30 years of missions:

Building the International Space Station

Launching legendary space missions

Carrying astronauts safely into orbit

After this flight, the shuttles were retired forever.
No more reusable wings.
No more iconic shuttle landings.
Truly… the end of an era 😢🚀

👉 This wasn’t just a launch.
It was history leaving Earth for the last time.
